Write your goals.
We'll point at courses.

Describe what you want out of the next year — a career direction, a skill gap, an industry, anything. This scans course titles, categories, and catalog descriptions across every SOM elective, cross-references it against what classmates actually said in Slack, and ranks what fits. It's a keyword-and-sentiment matcher running right in this page, not a model — read the "why" on each match and use your judgment.
